sources.name: city-of-star
sources.notes: CivicPlus calendar, same platform and robots.txt as City of Kuna: the list pages are allowed with a 10 second crawl delay, the iCalendar module and RSS.aspx are not. Calendars on 2026-11-05: City Council Meetings and Main Calendar. Meetings and closures are skipped by title, which left 2 events in November (Veterans Day Potato Feed, HALO Teen Meetup) and none in December. Configured 2026-11-05. Terms not read. 2026-11-08: probed again because Star shows only 1 or 2 events. Calendar.aspx is allowed (Crawl-delay 10; RSS.aspx and the iCalendar module are disallowed, and /iCalendar.aspx only links to them). Categories 14 Main Calendar, 22 City Council Meetings, 26 Hunter's Creek Sports Complex; the month pages already show all of them. Nov to Jan hold 9 events and only HALO Teen Meetup survives the filter (the rest are council and youth council meetings and closures), so more months or another category would not help. staridaho.org/events is a 404, and /recreation redirects to a department page whose classes and leagues are on hisawyer.com and teamsideline.com (not probed)

sources.name: estatesales-net
sources.notes: Permission given 2026-11-11, per the site owner; read from data/events-additional.json (salesMode file), which the ingest-additional workflow writes. Earlier: declined in writing 2026-11-09 (ticket 10407164) and was on doNotIngest. Owned by Auction Technology Group; do not contact ATG. Earlier (2026-11-08): Terms of service (Prohibited Uses) forbid 'using or attempting to use any engine, software, tool, agent, or other device or mechanism (including without limitation browsers, spiders, robots, avatars, or intelligent agents) to harvest or otherwise collect information from the Service for any use, including without limitation use on Third Party Websites', and the license bars reproducing or distributing any part of the Service for a commercial purpose without written consent. robots.txt itself allows the city pages. Needs written permission or a partner feed from EstateSales.NET Largest estate sale site; most Treasure Valley companies post here. Checked 2026-11-08. City pages (/ID/<City>, /ID/<City>/<ZIP>) are Angular with server-rendered state in script#estatesales-net-state: NGRX_STATE.ui.sales.saleRows has, per sale, name, orgName, cityName, postalCodeNumber, stateCode, typeName (EstateSales), pictureCount, utcShowAddressAfter, and dates[] with per-day local start and end; descriptions are on /print. /ID/Boise listed 2 sales on 2026-11-08 (83703 Garden City estate sale by Estate Liquidators Of Idaho, Nov 12 to 13; 83705 Hillcrest View Dr by Americana Estate Services, Nov 20 to 21). No further pages were fetched once the terms were read Earlier url: https://www.estatesales.net/ID/Boise.

sources.name: idaho-wine-commission
sources.excludeTitlePattern: (?i)happy hour|trivia|growler|board meeting|annual meeting|case sale|first fridays|^telaya wine co\b
sources.notes: Statewide winery events calendar of the Idaho Wine Commission. Suggested 2026-11-07. idahowines.org robots.txt allows everything. /events/month/?ical=1 answered 403, so the ICS is not used; the Events Calendar REST API answers with 665 upcoming events on 2026-11-07 (14 pages), running to 2028. Almost all are weekly repeats posted two years ahead: happy hours (VEER Wine Project, Rolling Hills, Vizcaya), Meriwether Cider trivia and growler fills, and commission board meetings. 442 of them start at 08:00, a placeholder time, as do VEER's First Fridays. excludeTitlePattern drops those, leaving one-off winery events such as Indian Creek Winery's arts and crafts days, Telaya Wine Co pop-up music and wreath making, Huston Vineyards and 3100 Cellars Thanksgiving weekend, and Savor Idaho. No event has a venue object; the winery is only the start of the title (Telaya Wine Co - Pop-Up Music), so city is Other and refine's city lookup reads the event page. The wineries named so far are in Garden City, Kuna, Caldwell and Eagle. Terms not read 2026-11-09: titles starting "Telaya Wine Co" are skipped, because telaya-wine reads Telaya's own calendar with the real venue (the Wine Commission listed them as Idaho wineries, city Other).

sources.name: mccall-winter-carnival
sources.notes: Added 2026-11-08 at the user's request so the McCall Winter Carnival is listed: it is not in visit-mccall's event feed or the City of McCall calendar (checked January and February 2027). The page heading is 'Winter Carnival 2027' with the dates under it ('Jan 28', a dash, 'Feb 6'), read as one all-day event; the Mardi Gras Parade (Feb 6) is part of it. yearFromTitle takes the year from the heading, so after the carnival the old page is read as past, not as next year. sources.name: fiddlers-contest
sources.notes: Weiser, third full week of June. Suggested 2026-11-08; www.fiddlecontest.org verified as the official site (the City of Weiser links to it; footer: National Oldtime Fiddlers, Inc, PO Box 447, Weiser). robots.txt allows the site (disallows only /wp-admin/ and Gravity Forms export paths). It runs The Events Calendar, but the REST API and ?ical=1 had 0 events (also none since 2025-01-01), and /schedule/ links only the 2026 schedule PDF. The dates are in the home page banner ('Fiddlers' Contest & Festival', 'June 21st – 26th, 2027 • Weiser, ID'), read here as one all-day event. The datePattern's second branch borrows the first date's month, and both read the year from the banner, so after the contest the old dates are past rather than next year's. If the banner changes, the source finds 0 events. Recheck the tribe API in spring: if daily events get posted, a tribe entry could replace this. Terms not read. Held 2026-11-08: the site answers HTTP 403 to the ingest client (PowerShell) for robots.txt and everything else, while curl with the same User-Agent gets 200, so it filters on how the client connects. The ingest treats a 403 as a refusal and does not change its client to get past it. The cards configuration is tested offline against the saved banner. Ask the site to allow the WeekendBoise User-Agent, then set running
